correctness.rationale: Rank-one idempotents correspond ordered distinct image/kernel lines in P1(Fq), q(q+1) total. A tuple generates unital M2 iff no common invariant line: fix P1=E11, obtain E21 from one P_i with nonzero (2,1) entry and E12 from possibly another with nonzero (1,2) entry, and both diagonal units from P1 and I. Inclusion–exclusion of common-line conditions truncates after pair intersections because each projector has exactly two invariant lines. Factor r=2 and special q=2,r=3 yield minimum sizes. Independently enumerated full algebra-span closure q=2 r<=4 and q=3 r<=3; finite checks corroborate general algebra proof.

value.rationale: Exact distribution for a natural constrained generating set in M2(Fq), revealing exceptional minimal arity in characteristic two and a closed all-r formula; useful as rigorous benchmark for constrained random matrix generation.

final_claim: For every prime power q and r>=1, ordered rank-one idempotent r-tuples generating M2(Fq) count [q(q+1)]^r-(q+1)(2q)^r+binom(q+1,2)2^r; minimal arity three for q=2 and two otherwise.
